title: Cardputer ADV MP3 Player v1.0.0 startup recheck

hardware.reason: No matching Cardputer ADV fixture was configured in the available device test center.

execution.environment: Device Service / native QEMU / ESP32-S3 / Cardputer ADV

checks.name: public_merged_image_identity
checks.detail: Public tagged binary and release asset matched the evaluated source bytes.

checks.name: baseline_rom_flash_boot
checks.detail: ROM read the SPI Flash segments and jumped to the second-stage bootloader entry.

checks.name: baseline_application_ready_frame
checks.detail: No nonblack pixels in the observed framebuffer.

checks.name: target_extended_ready_frame_without_media
checks.detail: At 5, 15, 35 and 65 seconds after running, all frames were black, serial held at 225 bytes, and readiness timed out.

checks.name: target_extended_ready_frame_with_media
checks.detail: FAT32/MBR media with synthetic MP3 was attached. All four target frames remained black and readiness timed out. Guest mount was not observed.

checks.name: same_board_reference_frame
checks.detail: UIFlow2 v2.5.3 showed its Offline interface by the 5-second sample and passed the same readiness predicate.

checks.name: target_application_image_execution
checks.detail: Both CPU PCs and VECBASE were within the exact target app0 executable segments in the isolated QMP diagnostic.

checks.name: mp3_function
checks.detail: The diagnostic build rendered the UI but SD mount failed; selection, decoding and playback were not reached.

checks.name: root_cause
checks.detail: Exact guest stack and memory prove the I2C1 HAL self-deadlock, while a controlled runtime A/B proves the virtual board's default Cap attachment triggers the black-screen path.

checks.name: retained_session_cleanup
checks.detail: All 20 owned sessions were stopped with history retained, mutable Flash released and no guest process left. All four owned services were stopped.

checks.name: alternate_native_runtime_comparison
checks.detail: The target remained black after 18 seconds, while the reference passed readiness using the same ROM, alternate runtime and FAT32/MBR image.

checks.name: target_panel_and_storage_traffic
checks.detail: Target issued panel read-ID command 0x04; no panel init, pixel-write or SPI SD commands were observed. Reference issued 0x11, 0x29, 0x2a, 0x2b and 0x2c and rendered a UI.

checks.name: target_i2c1_self_deadlock
checks.detail: loopTask TCB 0x3fcefa98 was both holder and waiter of the same ordinary mutex 0x3fcec7b4, with portMAX_DELAY.

checks.name: virtual_board_gpio_trigger
checks.detail: Removing only the four default virtual SPI Cap attachments on GPIO5/6 restored application UI in the same firmware, ROM, and SD configuration.

checks.name: target_application_screen_diagnostic_wiring
checks.detail: At 5, 12 and 20 seconds the same public firmware showed the no-card screen with and without attached media, with identical framebuffer SHA-256.

checks.name: target_sd_mount_diagnostic_wiring
checks.detail: The verified FAT32 fixture was attached but the guest reported FR_NOT_READY. Trace reached CMD0/CMD59, then no CMD8 or CMD17.

notes: The service running state is a process milestone. Application readiness was evaluated separately.
Raw API responses and exact internal session identities remain in local evidence; this record contains derived observations and source hashes.
